$comment: 听力训练营 L17（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，相似话题干扰：五段都在图书馆，分别讲开放时间/等一本书/儿童活动/丢书赔钱/电脑不能用）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段独白 5 空：数字、时间、姓名拼读 W-R-I-G-H-T、地名拼读 O-A-K-W-O-O-D、价格）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: Library News
intro: 五段都发生在图书馆：开到几点、想借的书被借走了、周六讲故事、书丢了要赔、电脑今天用不了。再听一段暑期阅读俱乐部的通知，记下本数、时间、老师、公园和奖品。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Welcome to the town library. From this month we are open until seven on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so you can come after work or school.
On other days we close at five, and we are closed on Sundays.

questions.q: What is the woman talking about?
questions.explain: open until seven / close at five / closed on Sundays——全是开放时间。新书和比赛都没说。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for the new book about space. I can't find it on the shelf.
Someone borrowed it yesterday. It will be back next Friday.
Can I put my name down for it, so nobody else takes it?
Of course. Write your name on this list, and we'll call you when it's back.

options: waiting for a book someone else has
questions.explain: someone borrowed it / back next Friday / put my name down——书被别人借走了，他排队等。不是买书，也不是还书。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Every Saturday morning from ten to eleven we have story time for children aged five to eight.
We read two stories and then draw pictures. It's free, and parents can wait in the café next door.

questions.q: What is the woman talking about?
questions.explain: story time for children aged five to eight / read two stories and draw——是给小孩子的活动。家长只是在隔壁等，电影没有。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: I've looked everywhere for my library book, in my bag, under my bed, and in the car, but I can't find it.
The library says I have to pay six pounds for a new one. That's all my pocket money for two weeks!

questions.q: What is the boy talking about?
options: finding a book in his bag
questions.explain: can't find it / have to pay six pounds for a new one——书丢了要赔钱。他没找到书，借书证也没提。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Sorry, everyone, the library computers are not working this afternoon. A man is coming to look at them at four.
If you need a computer for homework, the school library is open until five. We hope they will work again tomorrow.

questions.q: What is the man telling the people in the library?
options: The computers can't be used today.
There is a computer class at four.
questions.explain: the computers are not working this afternoon——今天用不了。四点来的是修电脑的人，不是新电脑也不是上课。

sections.intro: 听一段图书馆暑期阅读俱乐部的通知，把笔记补全。老师和公园的名字会拼出来。

script.text: Hello, and welcome to the Summer Reading Club. Here's how it works.
Over the summer, you read six books or more. Last year it was four, but you all read so fast that we made it six!
We meet every Friday at half past four to talk about the books. The library closes at five on Fridays, so we finish on time.
The club teacher is Miss Wright. That's W-R-I-G-H-T. She knows every book in the library.
At the end of the summer there's a party. It's not in the library this year, it's at Oakwood Park, O-A-K-W-O-O-D, by the lake.
Everyone who finishes gets a free book, and the best reader wins twenty pounds to spend in the bookshop. Happy reading!

questions.q: Summer Reading Club — Read: ______ books or more
questions.explain: read six books or more = 6。four 是去年的。
every Friday at half past four = 4:30。five 是图书馆关门时间。
Miss Wright. That's W-R-I-G-H-T——注意开头的 W 不发音，必须写上。
at Oakwood Park, O-A-K-W-O-O-D，照拼读写。今年不在图书馆办（not in the library）。

questions.q: Best reader wins: £______ to spend in the bookshop
questions.explain: the best reader wins twenty pounds = 20。free book 是每个完成的人都有的。
